summary: auth login --cookies-file requires only the HttpOnly __Host-instacart_sid session cookie (other Same-Day cookies kept when present, malformed optional ones dropped by name), accepts '-' for stdin plus DevTools 'Copy request headers' / 'Copy as cURL' (bash, cmd, PowerShell) pastes, and adds --diagnose, which reports byte count, format, parse stage and cookie names only, never values, and saves nothing.
reason: Post-merge smoke of 75f7fcbe: signed-in users could not log in because login demanded cookies Same-Day no longer sets (_instacart_session_id) and the HttpOnly session cookie cannot be copied from document.cookie.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/... green (stdin import, missing-session-cookie failure, session-cookie-only login); live read-only smoke at cd7b39e9 by the author: auth login --diagnose, auth status, session context, cart activecartid/carttotals, slots availableservices, live search all PASS with no cart or order actions. User report follow-up (2026-10-14): a cURL with no cookie points to Safari Web Inspector > Storage > Cookies and the echo ... | auth login --cookies-file - form; Expires=/Max-Age= attributes in a pasted cookie line set the session expiry (and are not sent as cookies); storage-state expiries are now saved for --cookies-file imports, so auth status and doctor show them.
